Could you please feel free to submit a PR for the requested change to be made.  Thank you!

> @Jerry-Ge, Could you please feel free to submit a PR for the requested change to be made. Thank you!

Np, I will do this one asap.
@tilakrayal hmm..I couldn't find where the source file is. It seems like it's called `g3doc/tf_ops.md` but I couldn't find it anywhere. Do you have any ideas?
The markdown is automatically generated from the .td file. If it is mangled that means someone added something unexpected. In this case it looks like TensorArrayConcatV3's doc.

> The markdown is automatically generated from the .td file. If it is mangled that means someone added something unexpected. In this case it looks like TensorArrayConcatV3's doc.

Tks Jacques! I will take a look at it. Hope it can be a quick fix!

Jerry
I'll do first round and ping some others (one has to update 1 doc & then get these regenerated and then script runs etc)

You can look into the .td file for the bug mentioned here.
https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/blob/015d944e641feedfe929d2585f935c40bb2f4943/tensorflow/compiler/mlir/tensorflow/ir/tf_generated_ops.td#L18436
I see a PR which is already merged here https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/commit/c4c472d2d8b52dcaca593590354ca14fe001bc0c in the above mentioned file, which should probably fix this issue.

Its a bit more complicate: https://github.com/tensorflow/tensorflow/commit/f82f6ca63947f918bae3de30d4b2be0682595130 shows the source documentation from which the td while is generated from which markdown is periodically generated which is processed by another process and periodically pushed ;)
